title: Inyenyeri cumi n'imwe zapfukamye
intro: Igishushanyo co muri Korowani carahawe iyerekwa rikomeye cane mu bwana — indoto y’ibintu vyo mw’ijuru bipfukama mu kwubaha. Imyaka yociye mu guhemuka, mu gutandukana, mu kuregwa ibinyoma no mu gufungwa imbere y’uko iyo mbonerakure iranguka. Uwo mutima ushikamye inkuru yiwe ifata igice kirekire kuruta ibindi vyose muri Korowani ni nde?
clues: Nari nari nkiri muto, ndahezagiwe n’indoto idasanzwe mbere na dawe bwite yamburiye ko ntazoyigira mu mpisho.
Bene wacu bwite, bahumye amaso n’ishari, barampamagaye, banjugunya mw’iriba rirerire kandi ry’umwiza.
Naratwawe mu gihugu ca kure, ndagurishwa mu nzu y’umukuru w’igihugu w’icubahiro, aho naronkeye ubutoni maze ndaduga mu nshingano.
Ibirego vy’ikinyoma vyatumye mfungwa ata co bimaze, yamara muri ico kibanza c’umwiza naronka ihumure mu gusenga no gupfukamira Allah.
Allah yampaye umuhezagiro w’ubushobozi budasanzwe bwo gusobanura indoto, amaherezo bikanshikana imbere y’umutware w’igihugu, bikanshira hejuru mu kibanza co hejuru co kwizigira.
Inyuma y’imyaka myinshi ntandukanye, narasubiye kubonana n’umuryango wanje nkunda, maze indoto yanje yo mu bwana y’inyenyeri cumi n’imwe, izuba n’ukwezi bipfukamira, amaherezo iraranguka.

options: Yasubiye kubonana n’umuryango inyuma y’imyaka myinshi batandukanye maze aba umusuku yizigirwa .

Yasohotse neza mu nda y'ikiremwa kinini inyuma y'imisi itatu .

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِى ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مِن مِّصْرَ لِٱمْرَأَتِهِۦٓ أَكْرِمِى مَثْوَىٰهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُۥ مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرِهِۦ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And the one from Egypt who bought him said to his wife, "Make his residence comfortable. Perhaps he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son." And thus, We established Joseph in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events [i.e., dreams]. And Allāh is predominant over His affair, but most of the people do not know. (12:21)
